pll2d5c3-d1e3514.summary: Answers that the converted angels were given cooperating grace, without which a rational creature cannot advance to the merit of life; it can fall by itself, but not advance without helping grace.
claims: Cooperating grace is necessary for merit.
The creature can fall by itself.

pl-l2d5c3.summary: Asks whether something was given to the converted angels after creation to turn them to God. Yes: cooperating grace, without which the rational creature cannot advance to the merit of life. It can fall by itself but cannot advance without helping grace.
claims: The converted angels received cooperating grace.
Without grace the rational creature cannot advance to merit.
The creature can fall by itself but cannot advance without grace.
